source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of list properties (PDF 92-93).

items: Dynamic Size (badalne wala size): Python ki list ka size badal sakta hai. Aap naye items jor sakte hain ya purane nikal sakte hain, aur list khud ba khud chhoti ya bari ho jati hai.

Index-Based Access (index se pohanch): List ke har item ki ek jagah hoti hai jise index kehte hain. Pehle item ka index 0, doosre ka 1, aur isi tarah aage. Index se aap koi bhi khaas item nikal sakte hain.
Ordered Collection (tarteeb wala majmooa): Items jis tarteeb se jore jayen, usi tarteeb mein rehte hain. Jo item pehle jora, woh pehli jagah par hi rahega jab tak aap khud na badlein.
Heterogeneous Elements (mukhtalif qisam ke items): Ek hi list mein mukhtalif qisam ke items ho sakte hain, maslan numbers, words aur doosri lists bhi.
Mutability (badle ja sakna): List banane ke baad bhi us ke items badle, jore ya nikale ja sakte hain.
Supports Duplicates (ek item kai baar): List mein ek hi item ek se zyada baar aa sakta hai.

blocks.text:
# Example List
items = ["Decorations", "Snacks", "Cold drinks", "Plates", "Balloons"]
# Characteristics of Lists:
# Nature of the Data Structure
print("List of items:", items)
# Mutability
items.append("Party Hats")
items.remove("Snacks")
print("After modifications:", items)
# Homogeneous vs. Heterogeneous
print("Homogeneous List:", [1, 2, 3, 4])
print("Heterogeneous List:", ["Apple", 42, 3.14, True])
# Properties of Lists:
# Length
print("Number of items:", len(items))
# Indexing
print("Item at index 2:", items[2])
# Ordering
print("Order maintained:", items)
# Duplication
print("List with duplicates:", ["Decorations", "Snacks", "cold drinks", "Snacks"])

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke code mein teen ghaltiyan hain: (1) "Plates" "Balloons" ke darmiyan comma nahi; Python dono strings ko jor kar 'PlatesBalloons' bana deta hai aur list mein chaar items reh jate hain. (2) 3. 14 mein number ke andar space hai, is liye SyntaxError aata hai; sahi 3.14 hai. (3) Indexing aur Ordering wale print() comment wali line par hi chhape hain, is liye woh comment ban gaye aur kabhi nahi chalte. Upar wale code mein har print() alag line par hai.

Upar wala code list ki mukhtalif khasusiyat dikhata hai. Pehle yeh 'items' naam ki list banata hai jis mein party ka saman hai, aur items usi tarteeb mein rehte hain jis mein jore gaye. Phir 'Party Hats' jor kar aur 'Snacks' nikal kar dikhaya gaya hai ke list badal sakti hai, yaani list dynamic hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Python mein lists nested ho sakti hain, yaani list ke andar list. Yeh pecheeda (complex) data ko dikhane mein kaam aata hai, maslan [[1, 2], [3, 4]].

blocks.prompt: Lists ki dynamic size wali property bataiye. Yeh lists ko lachakdar (flexible) kaise banati hai? (Long question 1)
blocks.explanation: Python list ka size pehle se tay nahi karna parta. append(), insert() aur extend() list ko bara karte hain; remove(), pop() aur clear() chhota karte hain; memory Python khud sambhalta hai. Is liye program aisa data bhi rakh sakta hai jis ki tadaad pehle maloom na ho, maslan user ka input, shopping cart ki cheezein ya kaamon ki list.

items: List ki khasusiyat: dynamic size, 0 se index, tarteeb qaim, mukhtalif qisam ke items, badle ja sakna, duplicates ki ijazat.
Code mein har item ke baad comma, number mein space nahi, aur print() alag line par.
